paragraphs.text: Clamfolk is a silver-bordered blue creature type for a species of humanoid clams. It was introduced in Unglued and later re-appeared in Unsanctioned .
Clamfolk are a parody of the Homarids from Fallen Empires . They were involved in a war with homarid -like crabfolk called the Crab War.
The 2024 Amsterdam Planechase Unknown event introduced Clamhattan as a plane on the Clamilton Estate playtest card .
